## 📢 Community Contributions

We want to hear from you! If you have items you'd like to see included in this edition, please leave a comment below using the following format:

```text
**Category:** [Calendar / News / Jobs / Blog posts & tools]
**Title:** **Link:** **Why it matters to the NL-RSE community:**
```

### 📦 Newsletter Sections
* **Intro:** Brief editorial note.
* **Dates for your calendar:** Events, conferences, deadlines, workshops, calls, etc.
* **News:** Community updates, announcements, reports, opportunities, etc.
* **Job postings:** Relevant research software, research engineering, data, or open science jobs.
* **Blog posts, tools & more:** Interesting articles, tools, podcasts, videos, guides, resources, etc.

---

## 🛠️ Editorial Checklist
- [x] Open newsletter issue
- [ ] Create newsletter branch `newsletter-<yyyy>-<mm>`
- [ ] Collect community input from issue comments
- [ ] Update newsletter status to **Closed for content**
- [ ] Draft newsletter content
- [ ] Proofread, checking dates and links
- [ ] Open pull request to merge newsletter branch into `main`
- [ ] Notify the core team that the PR is ready for review
- [ ] Resolve review comments and merge PR
- [ ] Update newsletter status to **Published**
- [ ] Send newsletter to mailing list
- [ ] Share announcement on UKRSE Slack Netherlands channel
- [ ] Share announcement on LinkedIn
